subject: Unable to sucessfull install R-INLA package

messages.author: 12d85c1a684d193d
messages.subject: Unable to sucessfull install R-INLA package
parts:
Hello,
Anyone who can help me fix my R-INLA installation in R!
I have tried installing the package using this code: install.packages("INLA",repos=c(getOption("repos"),INLA="https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable"), dep=TRUE)

But the installation is not completed because of the following issue:
Warning: dependencies ‘Rgraphviz’, ‘graph’ are not available

  There is a binary version available but the source version is later:
       binary   source needs_compilation
INLA 21.02.23 22.12.16             FALSE

installing the source package ‘INLA’

trying URL 'https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable/src/contrib/INLA_22.12.16.tar.gz'
Content type 'application/x-gzip' length 90416747 bytes (86.2 MB)
downloaded 86.2 MB

* installing *binary* package 'INLA' ...
cp: unknown option -- )
Try '/usr/bin/cp --help' for more information.
ERROR: installing binary package failed

How can I resolve this?

messages.author: f2474553d6c29da6
messages.subject: Re: Unable to sucessfull install R-INLA package
parts:
Try to install rgraphviz: https://github.com/kasperdanielhansen/Rgraphviz
Then, try to instal R-INLA again.
